severity_basis: Qualitative severity of the demonstrated source/measurement issue in its stated path, independent of visual magnitude or prevalence. Corroborating duplicates identify the same issue.

reviewed_findings.claim: Club pilot composition / orientation
reviewed_findings.evidence: Club mowing and tree tint controls exist. VQ-01d directly reports 100 m, 720p, 2.3/10° synthetic Stik trajectories and no human orientation scores; its backgrounds were not qualified. Ocala and Muncie are specific reference fields, not present-scene proof.
reviewed_findings.missing: Current 1080p frames/motion at matched span and elevation, plus blind bank/upright responses; no recolor on this evidence.

reviewed_findings.claim: Two selected Turbo paints may disagree with dusk light
reviewed_findings.evidence: vehicle_paints.json:714–728 selects the two materials. Chapa Noble:373–381 applies a fixed cool gradient to reflective metal albedo; Vitral:118–128 adds a fixed blue sheen. Both explicitly retain shape in probe-limited scenes. No evidence of inappropriate player-visible tint.
reviewed_findings.missing: Matched Workshop fallback, matte control and the selected skins under daylight, overcast, dusk, night.

reviewed_findings.claim: Low-elevation cloud composition
reviewed_findings.evidence: sky.gdshader:215–250,273–295 deliberately uses ordinary and stratus fade bands. Independently computed ordinary alpha multiplier 0.00616745 at elevation 2.3°. Storm banks are separate. The WMO reference describes real cloud families, not pilot visibility in this scene.
reviewed_findings.missing: Matched 2–15° production pan and legibility judgment; reject defect inference from constant alone.

reviewed_findings.claim: Club lake Beer path uses axial rather than ray distance
reviewed_findings.evidence: water_material.gd:35 and lake_terrain.gd:78 bind water.gdshader. Baseline lines 137–147,179–193 use axial separation. Independently computed absorbed fractions .601480959/.478235133 for identical 2 m ray at 0°/45°. PBRT 4e §11.2. Pinned GLES and clustered source use -normalize(vertex) for VIEW in the single-view path.
reviewed_findings.missing: Matched center/off-axis, near/orthographic/foreground controls, and real GPU measurement.

reviewed_findings.claim: Signed Gaussian argument to floating-point pow
reviewed_findings.evidence: lens_film.gdshader:70–82 calls pow with negative base for y>edge−.006. GLSL §8.2 explicitly leaves this undefined even if exponent is 2. Intended rim .1287578044 at ±1. The sample at y=edge+.002 is multiplied by zero sheet coverage; use a slightly negative covered offset to demonstrate a surviving change rather than relying on that boundary.
reviewed_findings.missing: Backend compile, signed covered-distance numeric test, held curtain images. No assertion of a visible failure on this driver.

reviewed_findings.claim: Absolute UV determinant discards valid normal maps on buildings/pit shelter
reviewed_findings.evidence: building_roofs.gdshader:18–30 and pit_shelter_roof.gdshader:132–147. Orthogonal equal-scale derivatives yield 1.23457e-6 at 900 px/tile vs 8.57339e-7 at 1080; conditioning stays one. Independent Pillow clay source (150,300) = (249,139,164), clay strength .67 gives 65.94495° norm tilt before texture filtering.
reviewed_findings.missing: Matched zoom/geometry, both owners and backends; verify signed mirror, collinear/zero, no-NaN and flat-map controls.

reviewed_findings.claim: Moon texture mip estimate loses 2D derivatives
reviewed_findings.evidence: moon_disc.gdshaderinc:77–100 uses radial derivative for both edge and texture LOD. Four symmetric offsets (±.1,±.1) give zero radial derivative even as map coordinates vary; independent true equatorial max footprint 65.629 texels → LOD 6.036263. Atmosphere binds real 2048/1024 width maps. Vector derivative remedy is a bounded filter heuristic; it is approximate near limb/pole.
reviewed_findings.missing: Matched subpixel phases, limb/pole and moonrise, reference supersampling and actual night captures. No claim of observed flicker yet.

reviewed_findings.claim: RC dirt GGX ignores per-light specular strength
reviewed_findings.evidence: ground.gdshader:344,373,398–412; DirtLoopSurface instantiated by airfield_track_view.gd. Active car spots use .35. Independently reopened pinned GLES rasterizer_scene_gles3.cpp:2075 and RD light_storage.cpp:1075; each sends 2×the positional setting. Correct multiplier .70 on this isolated contribution; does not imply 30% change in a scene pixel.
reviewed_findings.missing: Actual dirt patch with the same spot at 0/.35/.5 plus diffuse/directional and off-track controls.

reviewed_findings.claim: Already-lit lake bed is lit again by the water surface
reviewed_findings.evidence: water.gdshader:186–197 routes the opaque screen sample through ALBEDO. Both pinned GLES scene.glsl:2982 and Forward+ scene_forward_clustered.glsl:3141 multiply diffuse by albedo. Under specified black surface lighting/GI and masked sky, the bed contribution goes to zero; isolated physical contrast expected exp(-.001)=.999000500. Engine native refraction material.cpp:1815 uses emission with exposure compensation.
reviewed_findings.missing: Cross-backend native water reference including Compatibility in-pass tone mapping, output fog, ambient/probes, HDR exposure and a lit/emissive bed. Universal naive emission replacement unverified.

reviewed_findings.claim: Authored countryside hex colors used as RD-linear albedo
reviewed_findings.evidence: bake_countryside.py:33,91–105,237 converts #515351 to integer/255, and countryside.gd:54–71 puts RGB unconverted in ARRAY_COLOR. Shader uses it as ALBEDO. Expected red .082282707 versus .317647059. Independently scanned all 7168 indexed triangles; none has varying RGB. Pinned shader_types.cpp:87 exposes OUTPUT_IS_SRGB across spatial stages. UV2 owns tags/width. Decode only the author-proven palette.
reviewed_findings.missing: Bound Forward+/Mobile swatches and Compatibility open-air control; no claim all other art constants are encoded.

reviewed_findings.claim: Rigid windsock normals use diameter taper instead of radius taper
reviewed_findings.evidence: windsock_deformation.gdshaderinc:25–30,85–102,129–136; default.json:8561–69 overrides shader default. At 2.5 m and .45/.18 m diameters, slope -.054 gives 3.0909700° correct angle; implementation -.108 gives 6.1640524°. Exact argument is limited to rigid circular section.
reviewed_findings.missing: Position finite-difference reference at several rigid t/azimuths, deformed fabric and matching geometry/shadow frames.

reviewed_findings.claim: Aserradero periodic joint filter aliases at integral pitch
reviewed_findings.evidence: Selected paint aserradero.gdshader:26–27,42–44,70–76,101,124 computes derivative after folding. Pixel centers a 43 mm pitch apart sample identical folded distance; I recomputed expected slot coverage 1.1/43=.0255813953 regardless of phase. Baseline produces 0 or 1. Regional color impact is limited to this paint.
reviewed_findings.missing: Verify centered phase, both sides/negative coordinates, tiny through multiple pitches, stable pan, magnification. Keep unfolded derivatives in uniform flow.

reviewed_findings.claim: Same physical ray versus camera-axis issue as N1
reviewed_findings.evidence: Independently resolved as N1; second specialist describes the same shader term and counterexample. Count one unique finding.
reviewed_findings.missing: See N1.

reviewed_findings.claim: Same transmitted-bed relighting issue as L2
reviewed_findings.evidence: Independently resolved as L2. Additionally reopened pinned GLES ordinary output lines 2994–3006 showing exposure, optional tone mapping and sRGB write. Its opaque copy and color-space behavior constrain any implementation. Count one unique issue.
reviewed_findings.missing: See L2.

reviewed_findings.claim: Clamps distort the engine GGX density/visibility replicated for water
reviewed_findings.evidence: Baseline water.gdshader:268–270 clamps D and G to 1. Independently reopened cafc17a19 GLES scene.glsl:1588–1597, RD scene_forward_lights_inc.glsl:18–59 and half_inc.glsl:25,39. The latter clamps to half range or identity, not 1. Recomputed D=135.88121/24560.94801 at roughness .22/.06; G=3.250461 at symmetric cosines .26 (r=.22).
reviewed_findings.missing: Dim-light mirror-angle native tests, numerical upper bound for near-zero roughness, zoom/pan glint stability, HDR, cost.

reviewed_findings.claim: Lake reflectance and planar roughness filtering
reviewed_findings.evidence: I recomputed artistic F0=.16×.76²=.092416 vs Fresnel F0=.0203732 for representative n=1.333, and inspected the single bilinear planar fetch. Shallow refraction and sky/probe paths are art-calibrated; VQ-07 explicitly leaves roughness filtering open. Parameter discrepancy alone does not establish an unattractive frame; no replacement reflection system justified.
reviewed_findings.missing: Calibrated daylight/grazing reflection/shoreline on both techniques and actual performance.

reviewed_findings.claim: Rain curtain's derivative across wrapped UVs selects a false coarse mip
reviewed_findings.evidence: rain_curtain.gdshader:15–20 and storm_bank.gd:79–95. Independently opened shipped FX_CloudAlpha06 2048×2048: alpha endpoints at row floor(.46H) both zero, full-image mean 51.81723595/255. At 500 px sheet mip 3.61918 vs 10.99132 across wrap. Averages illustrate model; actual import/compositing determines screenshot.
reviewed_findings.missing: Electrical-storm rain at both seams, broad/interior controls, 1080p pan across quad phases. Verify selected import has mipmaps.

reviewed_findings.claim: Moon disc and veil attenuate differently under clouds
reviewed_findings.evidence: sky.gdshader:204–206,280–281 blends disc increment by 1−A; sun_glare.gd:174–185,250–257 with sky_mirror.gd:55–57 uses e^(−8A). I obtained .5 vs .01831564 for A=.5. Distinct input domains and nonlinear display adaptation mean equality is not a physical requirement for two displayed signals.
reviewed_findings.missing: Matched scene-linear Moon-disc increments, raw veil drive and on/off adapted contrast across a moving deck.

reviewed_findings.claim: Sky/ground cloud registration off the fixed pilot origin
reviewed_findings.evidence: L4b/sky.md explicitly documents pilot-centered sky without camera-world-XZ phase vs world-space ground; sky.gdshader constructs deck from directional ray. This is an existing approximation. New camera-position sky evaluation may incur additional radiance refreshes.
reviewed_findings.missing: Only assert a defect for a defined offset camera when matched sky/shadow images disagree beyond scope/tolerance.

reviewed_findings.claim: HX-700 rotor disc applies blade tint twice
reviewed_findings.evidence: Parsed both shipped HX-700 GLBs: all four actual blades reference Pala_Carbono; checked hx700_model.gd:86 and vehicle_paints.json:20. heli_rotor_blur.gd:265–272,292–295,318 places .165/.173/.188 RGB in vertex and material. Confirmed native albedo_tex*=COLOR and ALBEDO=albedo.rgb*albedo_tex.rgb in pinned binary. Fixed-wing uses white vertex RGB. 12/48 Hz at two blades =360/1440 RPM.
reviewed_findings.missing: Two rotors, static/intermediate/disc RPM images, alpha/geometry test. Ordinary correction belongs to existing GDScript mesh builder; native-only production delivery needs agreed supported integration.

reviewed_findings.claim: World vegetation uses wind at fixed-wing aircraft center under spatial shear
reviewed_findings.evidence: main.gd:298–301,1528; flight_session.gd:596–599,624–627 returns accepted aircraft position by default. World.update→ShaderClock→wind_vec→near grass and treeline shaders. field.gd:529–539 separately samples mast position. Confirmed _shear() 3 m/s 90° at 10m, z0=.03, layer (-.7,+.35) at 42m. Analytic 10m (0,-3), 42m (-.7,-3.391), 4m (0,-2.527) m/s.
reviewed_findings.missing: Same seed/tick/pilot crop and two aircraft altitudes, calm controls, separately supplied native field anchor. Never repurpose aircraft-local wind for all effects.

reviewed_findings.claim: Uniform dark-Moon return may precede projection/derivatives
reviewed_findings.evidence: moon_disc.gdshaderinc:67–80 computes derivatives before uniform zero return. sky.gdshader:204–206 calls on non-cubemap sky. Source admits skipping work on inactive frames; compiler optimization and GPU load preclude any speed claim.
reviewed_findings.missing: Byte-identical inactive frames and an enabled control. Actual real-GPU sky-pass timings for speed claims.

reviewed_findings.claim: Fixture resolution, renderer labels and sample attribution
reviewed_findings.evidence: capture_landscape_upgrade.gd:119–121,291,449–492 sets root size and uses a literal renderer label. Its timed process_frame/post_draw loop includes initial setup interval, and even-count median selects upper middle. render_probe.gd:96–108 labels absent/zero and unverified GPU reading freshness. Per-process resource sampling differs from viewport render CPU.
reviewed_findings.missing: Actual device and renderer, decoded PNGs, verified raw intervals, matched variants, independent repetitions and OS process measurement; broad fixtures do not cover all individual feature changes.

reviewed_findings.claim: Local or hosted software timing would prove real target GPU/frame rate
reviewed_findings.evidence: No physical GPU available to this worktree. Local dummy-renderer project tests, separate surfaceless shader tests, and hosted Mesa software runs each have distinct scope. No matching target GPU samples at intake.
reviewed_findings.missing: Real GPU campaign on named host at same renderer, pixels, time/scene and active production backend, plus wall/CPU/GPU/memory raw records.

numeric_receipts.instrumentation_scope: Program excerpts; rain computes an observed gradient-based LOD with substituted samplers; Moon returns the instrumented LOD before texture fetch. For roofs, shelter helper exercised and building path inspected separately; colors/windsock/light use scalar probes. No game imagery, performance or user-visible qualification.
numeric_receipts.attempt_history: shader-math-01 failed the baseline Moon oracle because the centered sample straddled derivative quads. Corrected phase selected a single hardware-style 2x2 derivative quad; new baseline LOD = 0 and candidate = 6.692645. Original retained.

summary.roof_geometry_and_bindings: 7 surfaces, 32 triangles, 9 mipmapped maps; also checks clockwise winding and UVs.
